schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (MAA Card)
schemes.department: Medical, Health & Family Welfare Department — Rajasthan State Health Assurance Agency (RSHAA), Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Rajasthan's own health cover, earlier called the Chiranjeevi Yojana and renamed MAA Yojana in 2024. A covered family gets cashless treatment of up to Rs 25 lakh a year when admitted to a government hospital or an empanelled private hospital, with no limit on family size or age. NFSA and SECC families, small and marginal farmers and government contract workers are covered free; any other family that is not a government employee or pensioner can join by paying Rs 850 a year.
schemes.benefit: Cashless hospital treatment up to Rs 25 lakh per family per year
eligibility: Family living in Rajasthan with a Jan Aadhaar card; every member listed on the Jan Aadhaar is covered
Free, no registration needed: families under the Food Security Act (NFSA) and SECC 2011 families
Free after registration: small and marginal farmers, contract workers of state departments, boards and corporations, and destitute families who got the Covid-19 ex-gratia
All other families can join by paying Rs 850 a year, half the premium; the state pays the other half
Not for government employees or pensioners who get medical benefits under the Medical Attendance Rules
No limit on family size or age; a baby up to one year old is treated even before its name is on the Jan Aadhaar
documents: Jan Aadhaar card, Jan Aadhaar number or Jan Aadhaar enrolment receipt number
Aadhaar number of the member who registers, with the mobile number linked to it for the OTP
Land holding seeded in the Jan Aadhaar, for small and marginal farmers (done at e-Mitra)
Department verification by the nodal officer, for contract workers
Rs 850 premium, only for families in the paid category
At the hospital: Jan Aadhaar card or the MAA policy document, and the patient's Aadhaar card
schemes.portalName: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana portal (through SSO Rajasthan)

demoFields.label: SSO ID
demoFields.hint: Your Rajasthan SSO login. If you have none, make one free on the same page using your Jan Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Registration type
demoFields.hint: Free is for small and marginal farmers, contract workers and Covid ex-gratia families. Every other family chooses Paid and pays Rs 850. NFSA ration-card families do not register at all.

demoFields.label: Free category
demoFields.hint: Farmers choose SMF, government contract staff choose Contractual, and destitute families who got the Covid aid choose Covid 19 ex Gratia.

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar number or enrolment receipt number
demoFields.hint: The 10-digit family number on the Jan Aadhaar card. If the card is still being made, the enrolment receipt number also works.

demoFields.label: Family member who e-signs
demoFields.hint: All members appear on screen. Pick any one adult whose Aadhaar has a working mobile number linked to it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number of that member
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on the Aadhaar card of the member you picked.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar OTP (e-signature)
demoFields.hint: The OTP goes to the mobile linked with Aadhaar, which may differ from the number on the Jan Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you keep with you. Messages about the policy come here.

demoFields.label: Land details (farmers only)
demoFields.value: Khasra 412, 1.6 hectare, village Kishanpura, tehsil Chomu
demoFields.hint: Must match the land seeded in your Jan Aadhaar. If it is not seeded yet, get it done at e-Mitra first.

demoFields.label: Premium (paid category only)
demoFields.hint: Paid families pay Rs 850 online or in cash at the e-Mitra. The kiosk may not charge anything extra for registering or printing.

demoSteps: Check first: if your family has an NFSA ration card or is in the SECC 2011 list, you are already covered. Just take your Jan Aadhaar or Aadhaar card to the hospital.
Everyone else logs in at sso.rajasthan.gov.in and opens the MAA Yojana registration, or goes to an e-Mitra kiosk with the Jan Aadhaar and Aadhaar.
Choose Free (farmer, contract worker, Covid ex-gratia family) or Paid, then enter the Jan Aadhaar number or its enrolment receipt number and search.
The family list appears. One adult member e-signs with the OTP sent to the mobile linked to their Aadhaar, then fills in the details for the chosen category.
Paid families pay Rs 850. Contract workers' forms are checked online by their department's nodal officer.
Print the policy document. It shows your family's cover; keep it with the Jan Aadhaar card.

At an empanelled hospital, go to the scheme counter, give the Jan Aadhaar or Aadhaar number and verify with your fingerprint. Listed treatment is free, including the tests and medicines from 5 days before admission to 15 days after discharge.
schemes.helpline: 181 — Rajasthan Sampark; 1800-180-6127 — MAA Yojana toll-free complaint line

schemes.title: Lado Protsahan Yojana (Lado Sankalp Patra)
schemes.department: Directorate of Women Empowerment, Women & Child Development Department, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: A girl born in a government hospital or a JSY-approved private hospital in Rajasthan is promised Rs 1.5 lakh, paid in seven instalments from birth until she graduates at 21. The scheme began on 1 August 2024, replaced the old Mukhyamantri Rajshri Yojana (Rajshri girls get their remaining instalments under Lado), and was raised from Rs 1 lakh to Rs 1.5 lakh in 2025. There is no form: the hospital, the school and the college record her details, and every instalment goes by DBT.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,50,000 in 7 instalments — Rs 2,500 at birth up to Rs 1 lakh at graduation
eligibility: The mother is a resident of Rajasthan and has an Aadhaar card and a Jan Aadhaar card
The girl is born in a government hospital or in a private hospital approved under Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
The guidelines set no income or caste condition, and no limit on the number of children for the 3rd instalment onwards
Instalments 3 to 6 need admission in a government school or a state-recognised private school
The last instalment needs graduation from a recognised institution and age 21 completed
A mother living in Rajasthan who delivered outside the state and got JSY can claim the first instalment at her local government hospital
documents: Mother's Aadhaar card
Jan Aadhaar card of the family; add the girl's name after birth
Bank passbook of the mother (father or guardian if the mother has died)
Pregnancy (ANC) registration done with the ANM or government hospital
Mamta card showing all vaccinations done by 9–12 months, for the 2nd instalment
School admission entry on Shala Darpan or the private school portal, for instalments 3 to 6
Graduation marksheet, for the 7th instalment
schemes.submitAt: No form and no fee. During pregnancy, register at the ANC check-up with the ANM, ASHA or government hospital and give the mother's Aadhaar, Jan Aadhaar and bank details for the PCTS entry. Deliver in a government hospital or a JSY-approved private hospital. School instalments come through the school's Shala Darpan entry and the last one through the college. For a missing instalment, ask the ANM or the Block Chief Medical Officer for the first two, the school head for instalments 3 to 6, or the district Women Empowerment office.

demoFields.label: Mother's name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the Aadhaar and the bank account, or the payment can bounce.

demoFields.label: Mother's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The ANM enters this at the first pregnancy check-up.

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The family's 10-digit Jan Aadhaar. If the family has none, get it made at e-Mitra before the delivery.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC (mother)
demoFields.hint: An account in the mother's own name. The first six instalments go to the parent; the last one goes to the girl.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Payment messages come here.

demoFields.label: ANC registration (place and date)
demoFields.hint: Register early in pregnancy with the ANM; this PCTS entry is what starts the scheme.

demoFields.label: Place of delivery
demoFields.hint: Only a government hospital or a JSY-approved private hospital counts. A home birth is not covered.

demoFields.label: Girl's PCTS / unique ID
demoFields.hint: Given at birth. Quote it for every instalment and at school admission.

demoFields.label: Full vaccination (Mamta card)
demoFields.hint: All vaccines due by 9–12 months. The second Rs 2,500 is paid once this shows on PCTS.

demoFields.label: School and class (later instalments)
demoFields.value: Govt. Senior Secondary School, Bilara — Class 1
demoFields.hint: The school enters her on Shala Darpan at Class 1, 6, 10 and 12, using her PCTS ID, Jan Aadhaar or APAAR ID.

demoSteps: Register the pregnancy at the first check-up with the ANM, ASHA or government hospital, and give the mother's Aadhaar, Jan Aadhaar, bank account and mobile number.
Deliver in a government hospital or a JSY-approved private hospital. The girl gets a PCTS ID and the family gets the Rs 1.5 lakh Sankalp Patra.
The first Rs 2,500 is credited to the mother's account after the hospital birth, without any application.
Complete all vaccinations by 9–12 months on the Mamta card. When PCTS is updated, the second Rs 2,500 is paid; no proof that the child is alive is asked.
Add the girl to the Jan Aadhaar. On admission to Class 1, 6, 10 and 12 the school records her, and the Education Department pays Rs 4,000, Rs 5,000, Rs 11,000 and Rs 25,000.
After she passes graduation and turns 21, Rs 1 lakh goes to her own account. Missing one stage does not stop the later instalments.
If a payment does not arrive, ask the ANM or the school to check the entry, or complain on 181.
schemes.helpline: 181 — Rajasthan Sampark (state helpline for complaints about any scheme)

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (Rajasthan top-up to PM-Kisan)
schemes.brief: Rajasthan adds its own money to PM-Kisan. Every Rajasthan farmer family that receives PM-Kisan also gets Rs 3,000 a year from the state, paid in instalments of Rs 1,000, so the total becomes Rs 9,000 a year with the Centre's Rs 6,000. There is no separate state form: a farmer registered and active in PM-Kisan gets the state money by DBT automatically.
schemes.benefit: Rs 3,000 a year from the state on top of PM-Kisan's Rs 6,000 (Rs 9,000 in all)
eligibility: Rajasthan farmer family that is an active PM-Kisan beneficiary
Farm land in own name as on 1 February 2019; land got later only by inheritance counts
One person per family — husband, wife and minor children count as one family
Farmer ID from the Rajasthan Farmer Registry, PM-Kisan e-KYC done, and an Aadhaar-linked bank account open for DBT
PM-Kisan exclusions apply: income-tax payers, government employees, pensioners drawing Rs 10,000 or more a month, doctors, lawyers and other registered professionals
documents: Aadhaar card, with a mobile number linked for OTP
Farmer ID (Rajasthan Farmer Registry), made free at e-Mitra, a CSC or a registry camp
Jamabandi (land record) copy showing the land in your name
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-linked account open for DBT
Mobile number

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The farmer's own 12-digit Aadhaar. The name on the land record must match it.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The OTP and every payment SMS come here.

demoFields.label: State
demoFields.hint: Choose Rajasthan; only then is the state's Rs 3,000 added.

demoFields.label: Farmer ID
demoFields.hint: From the Rajasthan Farmer Registry. Get it at e-Mitra, a CSC or a camp if you do not have one.

demoFields.label: District / tehsil / village
demoFields.hint: Where the farm land is, not where you live now.

demoFields.label: Farmer name and gender
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Category and farmer type
demoFields.hint: Small means 1 to 2 hectares and marginal means under 1 hectare. Every landholding size is eligible.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The account must be linked to Aadhaar for DBT, or the money fails.

demoFields.label: Land details (khata, khasra, area)
demoFields.hint: Copy them from your jamabandi. The patwari checks them against the land record.

demoFields.label: Self-declaration
demoFields.hint: You confirm that you are not in an excluded group such as an income-tax payer or a government employee.

demoSteps: Already in PM-Kisan? Check Know Your Status on pmkisan.gov.in. If you are active and e-KYC is done, the state money will come on its own; do nothing more.
Not registered? First get a Farmer ID at e-Mitra, a CSC or a Farmer Registry camp, carrying Aadhaar and the jamabandi.

Open New Farmer Registration on pmkisan.gov.in, enter Aadhaar and mobile, choose Rajasthan, verify the OTP, fill in the land and bank details and submit. Note the registration number. e-Mitra or a CSC can do this for you.
The patwari and the tehsil verify the land, and the state approves the record.
Finish e-KYC with an Aadhaar OTP, face authentication or a fingerprint at a CSC, and make sure the bank account is linked to Aadhaar.
Once active, PM-Kisan pays Rs 2,000 three times a year and the state pays its Rs 1,000 instalments separately, all by DBT.
Check payments on pmkisan.gov.in under Know Your Status, or on the Jan Soochna portal.

schemes.title: Palanhar Yojana (support for orphan and needy children)
schemes.department: Social Justice & Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Pays a monthly amount to the relative or guardian (the palanhar) who brings up an orphan, or a child in a listed hardship category, at home, so the child stays with family and keeps studying. Orphans get Rs 1,500 a month up to age 6 and Rs 2,500 from 6 to 18; other categories get Rs 750 and Rs 1,500, and most families also get Rs 2,000 a year for books, clothes and shoes. You apply online at an e-Mitra kiosk, through SSO or on the Palanhar app with face authentication, and renew every July.
schemes.benefit: Rs 750 to Rs 2,500 a month per child, plus Rs 2,000 a year
eligibility: Child under 18 (up to 19 if still in Class 12 or below), enrolled at an Anganwadi (age 0–6) or a school (6–18)
Orphans; children of parents sentenced to death or life imprisonment; children of a widow or a divorced or abandoned woman who gets a pension; children of a remarried widow
Children of parents with HIV/AIDS, leprosy, silicosis or 40% or more disability, and children of a mother who has gone in nata (widow and nata categories: up to 3 children)
Palanhar family income up to Rs 1.20 lakh a year; no income proof needed for BPL, Astha or Antyodaya card holders and widow, divorced, abandoned or disability pensioners
Palanhar is a Rajasthan native or has lived in the state at least 3 years; an adult brother or sister can be the palanhar
Stops if the palanhar takes a government job or family income crosses the limit
documents: Jan Aadhaar card of the palanhar, with the child added to it
Aadhaar card of each child
Residence proof — domicile certificate, ration card or voter ID (not needed for BPL, Astha, Antyodaya, PDS or pension holders)
Income proof of up to Rs 1.20 lakh a year (not needed for BPL, Astha, Antyodaya or pension holders)
Anganwadi registration or school study certificate (not needed if the school has verified the child on Shala Darpan)

Category proof: parents' death certificates, court sentence copy, pension PPO, remarriage certificate, AIDS control society registration, medical or 40% disability certificate, or the SDM's nata certificate
Bank account details, updated in the Jan Aadhaar

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar number of the palanhar
demoFields.hint: The child must already be added to this Jan Aadhaar, and the bank details in it must be correct.

demoFields.label: Palanhar name and relation to the child
demoFields.hint: The adult actually bringing up the child: grandparent, uncle, aunt, elder brother or sister, or the mother in the eligible categories.

demoFields.label: Category of the child
demoFields.hint: Choose the one category that fits; the amount and the proof needed depend on it.

demoFields.label: Child's name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: As on the child's Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Child's date of birth
demoFields.hint: Decides the rate: up to 6 years or 6–18 years. Get any error fixed in Jan Aadhaar first.

demoFields.label: Anganwadi or school and class
demoFields.value: Govt. Upper Primary School, Lalsot — Class 4
demoFields.hint: Children aged 0–6 must be at an Anganwadi and older children at school; money stops if the child leaves.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Up to Rs 1.20 lakh. Antyodaya, BPL and Astha card holders need no income certificate.

demoFields.label: Residence proof
demoFields.hint: BPL, Astha, Antyodaya or PDS card holders need no separate domicile certificate.

demoFields.label: Category document
demoFields.value: Death certificates of father (2021) and mother (2023)
demoFields.hint: Upload the proof for your category, such as a pension PPO for a widow or a disability certificate.

demoFields.label: Bank account (from Jan Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Taken from the Jan Aadhaar. To change it, update the Jan Aadhaar first, then tell the block office.

demoSteps: Make sure the child is added to the palanhar's Jan Aadhaar and that the bank details in the Jan Aadhaar are correct.
Apply online at the nearest e-Mitra kiosk, through your own SSO login, or on the Palanhar new-application app with Aadhaar face authentication, and attach the category papers.
Keep the application number. The Block Social Security Office of the Social Justice department checks the application.
If an objection is raised, clear it within 90 days at e-Mitra or on the app, or the application is cancelled automatically.
Once sanctioned, the monthly amount goes to the palanhar's account, with Rs 2,000 a year extra (not for widow and nata palanhars).
Every July, renew: the palanhar's life verification and the child's study proof, at e-Mitra or by face authentication on the renewal app, by December at the latest. Without it, payment stops.
Check status and payments at sjmsnew.rajasthan.gov.in/palanhaar/Appstatus.aspx using the application number or Jan Aadhaar.
schemes.helpline: 1800-180-6127 — Palanhar / Social Justice helpdesk; 181 — Rajasthan Sampark

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Matritva Poshan Yojana (MMMPY)
schemes.department: Directorate of Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS), Women & Child Development Department, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Gives Rs 6,000 in three instalments to a woman pregnant with her second child, for better food and care. It was earlier called the Indira Gandhi Matritva Poshan Yojana; only the name changed and the rules are the same. If the second baby is a boy, the third instalment is Rs 4,000; if it is a girl, she gets Rs 6,000 under the central PM Matru Vandana Yojana instead, making Rs 8,000 in all. There is no form: the Anganwadi worker or ANM records the pregnancy on PCTS and the money comes by DBT.
schemes.benefit: Rs 6,000 in 3 instalments for the second child (Rs 8,000 in all if it is a girl)
eligibility: Woman pregnant with her second child on or after 1 April 2022 (1 November 2020 in Pratapgarh, Dungarpur, Banswara, Udaipur and Baran)
Runs in all districts; pregnant or breastfeeding Anganwadi workers, helpers, ASHA sahyoginis and saathins are also eligible
Not for women regularly employed by the Centre, the state or a PSU, or getting the same kind of benefit under another law
Not eligible if the first pregnancy gave twins, or if after remarriage either partner already has more than one child
Cannot take MMMPY and PM Matru Vandana instalments for the same conditions
After a miscarriage or still birth, she stays eligible in a later pregnancy
documents: Jan Aadhaar card (it will be made at registration if the family has none)
Mamta card (mother and child protection card) — photocopy
Bank passbook copy of the account linked to the Jan Aadhaar
Mobile number
Aadhaar card of the woman
schemes.submitAt: No form and no fee. Register the pregnancy at the Anganwadi centre, or with the ANM at the sub-centre or government hospital, within 120 days of the last period. Give the Jan Aadhaar, Mamta card, bank passbook and mobile number for the PCTS entry; the instalments then come on their own as the check-ups and the hospital delivery are recorded. For a missing instalment, ask the Anganwadi worker or the CDPO (ICDS project office) of your block.

demoFields.label: Woman's name
demoFields.hint: As on the Jan Aadhaar and the bank account.

demoFields.label: Husband's name
demoFields.hint: As on the Jan Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Must be given at registration. If the family has none, the Anganwadi worker will help get it made.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Payment messages come here.

demoFields.label: Last menstrual period (LMP) date
demoFields.hint: The first instalment needs registration within 120 days of this date.

demoFields.label: Pregnancy number and living children
demoFields.hint: MMMPY is for the second child only. The first child is covered under PM Matru Vandana Yojana.

demoFields.label: ANC registration date and place
demoFields.hint: Register as early as you can; this PCTS entry is your application.

demoFields.label: Mamta card number
demoFields.hint: Every check-up and vaccine is written on this card. Keep it safe.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Your own account linked to the Jan Aadhaar. The money is paid only by DBT.

demoFields.label: Place of delivery
demoFields.hint: The third instalment needs a hospital delivery.

demoSteps: As soon as you know you are pregnant, and within 120 days of the last period, go to the Anganwadi worker or ANM and register. Give your Jan Aadhaar and mobile number.
Get your Mamta card. Your details go on PCTS; there is no form to fill.
First instalment: Rs 1,000 is paid after registration within 120 days.
Second instalment: Rs 1,000 after at least two check-ups within the first six months of pregnancy.
Deliver in a hospital. For a boy (or transgender child) the third instalment is Rs 4,000; for a girl, Rs 6,000 comes in one go under PM Matru Vandana Yojana instead.
The money goes to the account linked to your Jan Aadhaar, with an SMS. If an instalment is missing, ask the Anganwadi worker to check the PCTS entry, or call 181.
schemes.helpline: 181 — Rajasthan Sampark; your Anganwadi worker or the block CDPO office for PCTS entries

schemes.title: Nirman Shramik Panjiyan — BOCW Welfare Board (Shramik Card)
schemes.department: Rajasthan Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Registers a construction worker with the state welfare board and gives a beneficiary identity card, the shramik card. With it the worker and family can claim the board's schemes: Rs 55,000 under Shubhshakti for a woman worker or an adult unmarried daughter, Rs 21,000 maternity help for a girl and Rs 20,000 for a boy, scholarships for children, up to Rs 1.5 lakh towards a house, and Rs 5 lakh if the worker dies in an accident. Registration is online through SSO and the Labour Department's LDMS, by the worker or at an e-Mitra kiosk.
schemes.benefit: Shramik card for the board's schemes — Rs 55,000 Shubhshakti, Rs 20,000–21,000 maternity help, Rs 5 lakh accident cover
eligibility: Construction worker aged 18 to 60
At least 90 days of building or construction work in the last 12 months
Work certificate from the employer or contractor, a registered construction workers' union, the Panchayat executive officer or the area labour inspector
Pays the Rs 25 registration fee and Rs 60 contribution when the labour office asks, and keeps the contribution paid
Scheme benefits need time on the register: 3 months for Shubhshakti, 6 months to a year for housing help, 3 years for the toolkit
documents: Jan Aadhaar card and Aadhaar card
Construction worker certificate for 90 days' work in the last 12 months, signed and sealed with a phone number
Age proof — school leaving certificate, birth certificate or a doctor's certificate
Recent passport-size colour photograph (scanned)
Bank passbook first page, needed for scheme payments
Mobile number
Names and ages of family members, and the nominee's details

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number

demoSteps: Get the 90-day construction worker certificate signed and sealed by your contractor, a registered union, the Panchayat executive officer or the labour inspector.
Log in at sso.rajasthan.gov.in (make a free SSO ID with Jan Aadhaar if needed) and open LDMS, or go to an e-Mitra kiosk.
In LDMS choose BOCW Welfare Board, then Beneficiary Registration, and fill in Form V: your details, address, employers of the last 12 months, family and nominee.
Upload the photo, age proof and worker certificate, choose your labour office, tick the declaration and submit. Save the application number.

The labour office checks the form. If it asks for a missing paper, upload it from the same login. When approved, it asks you to pay the Rs 25 registration fee and Rs 60 contribution online or at e-Mitra.
After payment, print your beneficiary identity card (shramik card) from Print Identity Card in LDMS.
Apply for schemes from Apply for Scheme in the same login, for example maternity help within 90 days of the delivery. Keep the contribution paid so claims are not refused.
schemes.helpline: 1800-1800-999 — Labour Department helpline; 0141-2222961 / 0141-2220334 — construction worker schemes; 0141-2450793 — LDMS help
